run_ray_intersection: run ray intersection against primitive geoms using the ray function with model, data, origin, and direction arrays
run_rays_multiworld: run batched ray intersection across multiple worlds and rays with optional geom group filtering and body exclusion
run_rays_bvh_accelerated: run BVH-accelerated ray intersection using a RenderContext for efficient mesh and hfield ray casting
test_ray_capsule_intersection: test ray intersection with capsule geometry returning distance and surface normal in world space
test_ray_box_intersection: test ray intersection with box geometry returning distance, per-side hit info, and surface normal
